Description: App-level role assignments for AEWTTR-PULSE. Active records = people associated with PULSE (AEWTTR tab).
Project and portfolio risks with likelihood/impact scoring, mitigation, and meeting review state.
Tracker tasks and checklist items (see Source field). Subtasks are stored as nested JSON in SubtasksJson.
Weekly Meeting sessions, global and per-project.
Travel requests — standard or engineering submissions.
Post-trip debriefs linked to a travel request. One row per traveler — a multi-traveler request can have one debrief each.
One-day, non-travel team events displayed on the PULSE calendar.
Documents moving through review, concurrence, and signature.
Global people groups (Admin-managed + project auto-groups). Used in people pickers app-wide; Document Review expands a selected group into individual reviewers.

Slide content for a Portfolio/Program/End Item Config's combined status slide, and which member projects are currently included in its export deck — these groups are just name tags on individual projects, not their own SharePoint records, so this list is the one place to persist group-level Technical Status bullets, a formatted Description, a Risk Summary, extra ad-hoc milestones (beyond each member project's own Contract/FAT/SAT/etc. dates), the one photo (pulled from a member project's Photos tab) representing the config, and the deck's project inclusion selection.
Append-only record of user actions across AEWTTR-PULSE. Admin access only.
User-submitted PULSE issue reports, including page context, diagnostics, and a full-resolution screenshot file. Admin access only.
Support tickets created by PULSE users — blockers, bugs, access needs, platform issues, and questions.
Outbound notification queue for Power Automate. BodyHtml stores Adaptive Card JSON for Teams.
Single-row settings for outbound Teams/email notifications.
Single-row, admin-managed catalogs for locations, portfolios, contractors, contractor employees, and config end items.
